CASE WHEN us.id IS NOT NULL AND us.status = 'active' AND us.current_period_end IS NOT NULL AND us.current_period_end > #{now} AND us.plan_code != 'free' THEN 'active' WHEN us.id IS NULL THEN 'free' ELSE 'expired' END
mapper.select:
SELECT u.id AS userId, u.email, u.phone, u.nickname, u.status AS userStatus, AS planCode, CASE WHEN = 'free' THEN free_plan.name ELSE paid_plan.name END AS planName, AS subscriptionStatus, CASE WHEN = 'free' THEN 'daily' ELSE 'monthly' END AS quotaPeriod, CASE WHEN = 'free' THEN COALESCE(free_plan.daily_token_limit, 0) ELSE COALESCE(paid_plan.monthly_token_limit, 0) END AS tokenLimit, CASE WHEN = 'free' THEN COALESCE(daily_usage.token_used, 0) ELSE COALESCE(monthly_usage.token_used, 0) END AS tokenUsed, GREATEST(0, CASE WHEN = 'free' THEN COALESCE(free_plan.daily_token_limit, 0) - COALESCE(daily_usage.token_used, 0) ELSE COALESCE(paid_plan.monthly_token_limit, 0) - COALESCE(monthly_usage.token_used, 0) END) AS tokenRemaining, CASE WHEN = 'free' THEN COALESCE(daily_usage.token_used, 0) >= COALESCE(free_plan.daily_token_limit, 0) ELSE COALESCE(monthly_usage.token_used, 0) >= COALESCE(paid_plan.monthly_token_limit, 0) END AS overLimit, us.current_period_start AS currentPeriodStart, us.current_period_end AS currentPeriodEnd, #{usageMonth} AS usageMonth, #{usageDate} AS usageDate FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_subscription us ON us.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN subscription_plan paid_plan ON paid_plan.plan_code = us.plan_code AND paid_plan.active = 1 LEFT JOIN subscription_plan free_plan ON free_plan.plan_code = 'free' AND free_plan.active = 1 LEFT JOIN user_ai_token_usage_monthly monthly_usage ON monthly_usage.user_id = u.id AND monthly_usage.usage_month = #{usageMonth} LEFT JOIN user_ai_token_usage_daily daily_usage ON daily_usage.user_id = u.id AND daily_usage.usage_date = #{usageDate}
ORDER BY CASE WHEN = 'active' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, us.current_period_end DESC, u.created_at DESC, u.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_subscription us ON us.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN subscription_plan paid_plan ON paid_plan.plan_code = us.plan_code AND paid_plan.active = 1 LEFT JOIN subscription_plan free_plan ON free_plan.plan_code = 'free' AND free_plan.active = 1 LEFT JOIN user_ai_token_usage_monthly monthly_usage ON monthly_usage.user_id = u.id AND monthly_usage.usage_month = #{usageMonth} LEFT JOIN user_ai_token_usage_daily daily_usage ON daily_usage.user_id = u.id AND daily_usage.usage_date = #{usageDate}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM users) AS totalUsers, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_subscription us WHERE us.status = 'active' AND us.current_period_end IS NOT NULL AND us.current_period_end > #{now} AND us.plan_code != 'free') AS subscribedUsers, ( (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM users) - (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_subscription us WHERE us.status = 'active' AND us.current_period_end IS NOT NULL AND us.current_period_end > #{now} AND us.plan_code != 'free') ) AS ordinaryUsers, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM users u WHERE DATE(u.created_at) = #{today}) AS todayNewUsers, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_subscription us WHERE us.status = 'active' AND us.plan_code != 'free' AND DATE(us.current_period_start) = #{today}) AS todayNewSubscriptions, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.token_used), 0) FROM user_ai_token_usage_daily d WHERE d.usage_date = #{today}) AS todayFreeTokenUsed, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.total_tokens), 0) FROM ai_token_usage_event e INNER JOIN user_subscription us ON us.user_id = e.user_id WHERE DATE(e.occurred_at) = #{today} AND us.status = 'active' AND us.current_period_end IS NOT NULL AND us.current_period_end > #{now} AND us.plan_code != 'free') AS todayPaidTokenUsed, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_subscription us ON us.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN subscription_plan paid_plan ON paid_plan.plan_code = us.plan_code AND paid_plan.active = 1 LEFT JOIN subscription_plan free_plan ON free_plan.plan_code = 'free' AND free_plan.active = 1 LEFT JOIN user_ai_token_usage_daily daily_usage ON daily_usage.user_id = u.id AND daily_usage.usage_date = #{today} LEFT JOIN user_ai_token_usage_monthly monthly_usage ON monthly_usage.user_id = u.id AND monthly_usage.usage_month = #{usageMonth} WHERE CASE WHEN us.id IS NOT NULL AND us.status = 'active' AND us.current_period_end IS NOT NULL AND us.current_period_end > #{now} AND us.plan_code != 'free' THEN COALESCE(monthly_usage.token_used, 0) >= COALESCE(paid_plan.monthly_token_limit, 0) ELSE COALESCE(daily_usage.token_used, 0) >= COALESCE(free_plan.daily_token_limit, 0) END) AS overLimitUsers, (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN us.status = 'active' AND us.plan_code != 'free' AND DATE(us.current_period_start) BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{today}, INTERVAL 6 DAY) AND #{today} THEN us.user_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT u.id), 2 ) END FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_subscription us ON us.user_id = u.id WHERE DATE(u.created_at) BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{today}, INTERVAL 6 DAY) AND #{today}) AS sevenDaySubscriptionRate

SELECT p.plan_code AS planCode, p.name AS planName, COALESCE(plan_counts.user_count, 0) AS userCount, CASE WHEN totals.total_users = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(plan_counts.user_count, 0) * 100.0 / totals.total_users, 2) END AS ratio, p.sort_order AS sortOrder FROM subscription_plan p CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(1) AS total_users FROM users ) totals LEFT JOIN ( SELECT effective_plan.plan_code, COUNT(1) AS user_count FROM ( SELECT u.id, CASE WHEN us.id IS NOT NULL AND us.status = 'active' AND us.current_period_end IS NOT NULL AND us.current_period_end > #{now} AND us.plan_code != 'free' THEN us.plan_code ELSE 'free' END AS plan_code FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_subscription us ON us.user_id = u.id ) effective_plan GROUP BY effective_plan.plan_code ) plan_counts ON plan_counts.plan_code = p.plan_code WHERE p.active = 1 ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC

WITH RECURSIVE dates AS ( SELECT #{dateFrom} AS statDate UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(statDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM dates WHERE statDate < #{dateTo} ) SELECT dates.statDate AS statDate, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM users u WHERE DATE(u.created_at) = dates.statDate) AS newUsers, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_subscription us WHERE us.status = 'active' AND us.plan_code != 'free' AND DATE(us.current_period_start) = dates.statDate) AS newSubscriptions, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_subscription us WHERE us.status = 'active' AND us.plan_code != 'free' AND us.current_period_start <= DATE_ADD(dates.statDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND us.current_period_end > dates.statDate) AS subscribedUsers, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM users u WHERE u.created_at < DATE_ADD(dates.statDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) - (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_subscription us WHERE us.status = 'active' AND us.plan_code != 'free' AND us.current_period_start <= DATE_ADD(dates.statDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND us.current_period_end > dates.statDate) AS ordinaryUsers, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.token_used), 0) FROM user_ai_token_usage_daily d WHERE d.usage_date = dates.statDate) AS freeTokenUsed, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.total_tokens), 0) FROM ai_token_usage_event e INNER JOIN user_subscription us ON us.user_id = e.user_id WHERE DATE(e.occurred_at) = dates.statDate AND us.status = 'active' AND us.plan_code != 'free' AND us.current_period_start <= e.occurred_at AND us.current_period_end > e.occurred_at) AS paidTokenUsed, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM users u WHERE DATE(u.created_at) = dates.statDate) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_subscription us WHERE us.status = 'active' AND us.plan_code != 'free' AND DATE(us.current_period_start) = dates.statDate) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM users u WHERE DATE(u.created_at) = dates.statDate), 2 ) END AS subscriptionRate FROM dates ORDER BY dates.statDate DESC
